newsitem.title: CHINA: Chesterfield places HK$106 mln new shrs.
newsitem.headline: Chesterfield places HK$106 mln new shrs.

text.p: Chesterfield Ltd said on Thursday it would place 390 million new shares, or 16.51 percent of its enlarged share capital, to at least six third-party investors, raising net proceeds of HK$106 million.
The property investment and food manufacturing concern said it would place the shares at HK$0.28 each.

Of the proceeds, HK$30 million will be used to finance flour mill operations in China, with the balance of HK$76 million for working capital for other business and investment opportunities, Chesterfield said.
"There is no current negotiation or plan with respect to these business or investment opportunities," it said.
The stake of Chesterfield's substantial shareholder Li Chi Sing will be reduced to 15.34 percent from 18.37 percent on completion of the deal on August 31, it said.
Chesterfield shares were up HK$0.005 to HK$0.315 at midsession.
